title: Beat / Rate My Professor
notes:
My journey starts in a 2022 databases class, when I went head to head with my favorite professor. 
        The final project required us to use 400k items to create a usable demonstration of the datas utility. 
        All datasets used had to be publicly available.

        I didnt like this constraint, I wanted to use MY data. I challenged his rule. He insisted my team would be scored more strictly.

points: Public datasets only—I wanted to use my own
